app.label: Our Notes Auto Play
app.description: Auto-play for BanG Dream! Our Notes (International and Japanese servers): sends touches according to the chart and automatically navigates Free LIVE for continuous play.
setting.global.desc: Settings that apply to every task, such as the touch method
setting.stats.desc: Total run time, play data and achievement badges (updated after every play; reopen Settings to refresh)
opt.SongMode.current.desc: Always play the song currently selected on the Select Song screen
opt.SongMode.random.desc: Use the Random button on the Select Song screen to switch songs each round
opt.SongMode.ap_first.desc: Filters the selected difficulty by "NO ALL PERFECT" and picks songs at random (up to 3 plays per song); once no songs are left to fill, switches back to unfiltered random selection. With Difficulty set to "Highest Difficulty First", fills EXPERT → HARD → NORMAL → EASY in order, then picks EXPERT songs at random when all are done. Restores the filter and category afterward
opt.SongMode.list.desc: Plays the song list in order and starts over after each pass. Each round finds the next song in the "All" category list (scrolling while matching jackets; the first search may take 20–30 seconds); locked or unfound songs are skipped. Restores the category afterward
opt.SongList.songs: Song IDs or titles, comma-separated; optionally add @difficulty, e.g. 100010, 碧天伴走@hard
opt.Difficulty.high_first.desc: With Song Selection set to "Non-AP Songs First", fills non-AP songs EXPERT → HARD → NORMAL → EASY in order, then picks EXPERT songs at random when all are done (rotates through songs in Challenge LIVE); other song selection modes play EXPERT
opt.Touch.desc: minitouch writes directly to the emulator's touchscreen device and is the most stable; if it fails to start, the MuMu interface is used automatically
opt.Touch.mumu.desc: May occasionally drop or delay a batch of simultaneous touches
opt.HumanGreat.desc: Deliberately hits a small share of notes as GREAT each round (only plain taps with no other notes right before or after, 64–69ms early or late), so the result won't be AP. AP Completion and the "Non-AP Songs First" song selection are unaffected
opt.HumanTiming.desc: Press timing drifts slowly and randomly over time while staying within the PERFECT window, so FAST/SLOW on the result is more spread out
opt.HumanPosition.desc: Picks a random press position within the note (keeping a small margin on each side) instead of always pressing the center
opt.WatchCombo.desc: Monitors the combo count during play and lists the notes around combo breaks in the log afterward
opt.RestartLowFps.desc: During continuous play, if the game gets laggy (frame rate below 50 over the last 5 syncs), restart it before the next song; when off, never restart for this reason
opt.GameLanguage.desc: On the International server, match the language selected under "Language" in the Menu at the top right of the game's title screen; 한국어 needs a separate Korean text recognition model. For the Japanese server, choose "日本語 (Japanese server)"
opt.DebugLog.desc: Also show sync, chart, touch and image recognition details in the UI log; everything is written to data/ournotes.log either way
opt.CheckUpdate.desc: When running tasks, checks GitHub for a newly released version and, if there is one, notes it at the end of the log
opt.AutoUpdate.desc: Downloads a new version in the background and switches to it when no task is running; updates that need the UI restarted do so after the UI has been idle for 2 minutes (if the UI is set to start tasks as soon as it opens, it waits until you close the UI). Requires "Check for Updates"
opt.Proxy.desc: Proxy used to download charts, song lists, jackets, OCR models and to check for updates, e.g. 127.0.0.1:7890. If your browser can open haneoka.org but downloads keep failing here, enter the HTTP port of your proxy software; leave empty to use the system proxy
opt.NotifyChannel.desc: Sends a message to your phone when playing or Claim Dailies finishes, when a task ends with an error, and when AFK Farming runs into server maintenance. Tasks you stop yourself are not notified. After choosing a service and entering the notification address, run "Test Notification" in Tools to check that it arrives
opt.NotifyChannel.ntfy.desc: Free, no sign-up: install the ntfy app on your phone (Android, iOS), subscribe to a topic name nobody can guess (letters, digits, - and _), and enter the topic name in "Notification Address"
opt.NotifyChannel.serverchan.desc: Pushes to WeChat: log in at sct.ftqq.com by scanning with WeChat, copy the SendKey and enter it in "Notification Address". The free plan only allows a few messages a day, so you may want to notify only errors and maintenance
opt.NotifyChannel.bark.desc: Pushes to iPhone: install Bark from the App Store, open it, copy the URL it shows (such as https://api.day.app/your-key/) and enter it in "Notification Address". Errors are sent as Time Sensitive notifications, so they get through even when a Focus is on
opt.NotifyChannel.webhook.desc: POSTs the message as JSON (event, title, text, time) to the URL in "Notification Address", for your own bot or another notification service
opt.NotifyTarget.desc: For ntfy, the topic name (for a self-hosted ntfy server, the full URL); for ServerChan, the SendKey; for Bark, the URL copied from the app (or just the key); for Webhook, the URL. Treat it like a password and don't share it; it is never written to the logs
task.Start.desc: Launches the game if it isn't running and waits until the Home screen: taps through the title screen, claims login bonuses and closes the News. Every other task except Open Stats Window and Test Notification does this by itself first, so it doesn't need to be checked; checking it alone just gets the game to the Home screen.
task.SwitchAccount.desc: Logs out of the current bilibili account, logs in to the specified account from the game's login history (no password needed), then enters the game; if already in the game, restarts the game first to get back to the title screen. Can only switch to accounts in the login history: log in to a new account manually in the game once first. To rotate between multiple accounts, order the task list as "Switch Account (A) → other tasks → Switch Account (B) → other tasks", with each Switch Account set to its own account name.
opt.Account.account: Account name (the name shown in the login history; part of it is fine, as long as it matches only one account)
task.Repeat.desc: Plays continuously in Free LIVE. When LB is short, the game consumes all that is left (or none if there is none); when "LIVE Boost Recover" pops up, only taps Cancel and continues with 0 consumption. With "Refill LB with Items When Low" on, first tops up with Boost Drinks (never Stars, never ads).
task.ClearLB.desc: Plays continuously in Free LIVE until LIVE BOOST runs out (checks the count held at the top right before each round and stops at 0). Never uses Stars; with "Refill LB with Items When Low" on, first refills with Boost Drinks from Items, and only stops when the drinks run out (or the set amount has been refilled).
task.Idle.desc: Like Use Up LB, plays until LIVE BOOST runs out, then waits on the Formation screen, following the recovery countdown at the top right until LB recovers to the per-round cost (1 every 30 minutes), then continues; runs until stopped manually (or the round limit is reached). With LB per round set to 0 it doesn't wait: uses 1 per round while LB is held, then continues at 0 once it runs out, playing nonstop. Logs in again if the date changes while waiting. With "Scheduled Claim" on, returns to the Home screen to claim Studio Practice at the start and every few hours afterward; with "Claim Dailies Each Day" on, returns to the Home screen once a day at the set time to claim missions, the Gift Box and other daily rewards (the game's date changes at 3:00 every day, so nothing is missed when AFK farming across days). Never uses Stars; with "Refill LB with Items When Low" on, first refills with Boost Drinks from Items, and only starts waiting when the drinks run out (or the set amount has been refilled). It never ends by itself, so put it last in the task list.
task.AP.desc: Plays the songs in the selected difficulties that aren't ALL PERFECT yet until they are AP: switches the Select Song screen to the "All" category, filters each difficulty by "NO ALL PERFECT" and picks songs at random. A song that still isn't AP after enough attempts is skipped; locked songs are re-picked. Restores the filter and category after finishing normally.
task.Challenge.desc: Enters "CHALLENGE LIVE" from the LIVE top page (only open during some events; ends with an error otherwise) and plays continuously, spending Challenge Pts (CP) each round until CP isn't enough for another round. Before the first round, selects the per-round cost in the CP settings (default 200, the cheapest, allowing the most rounds). Doesn't use LB and never taps "SKIP" on the Formation screen.
task.Assist.desc: Only plays the notes for you: pick the song and tap LIVE START yourself, and it plays automatically once the play screen appears. It taps nothing for song selection, starting, result pages or popups, except tapping ⇄ once on the result page to read FAST/SLOW (for records and offset correction). The song is recognized on the Formation screen, so go through it; works in Free LIVE and Challenge LIVE. If you pause and tap Retry during play, it plays that song again; if sync fails, that round is skipped and you can pause and retry yourself. Runs until stopped manually and never restarts the game.
opt.ChallengeSongMode.rotate.desc: After each round, selects the next song in the list, going back to the first after the last
opt.ChallengeSongMode.ap_first.desc: Before each round, checks song by song on the Challenge LIVE song selection screen whether the selected difficulty is ALL PERFECT, and plays non-AP songs first (up to 3 plays per song); once all are AP, switches to rotating through songs. With Difficulty set to "Highest Difficulty First", fills EXPERT → HARD → NORMAL → EASY in order, then rotates through songs on EXPERT when all are done
opt.ChallengeCost.desc: Spending more gives more rewards, EXP and Event Pts per round (200 is ×1, 1600 is ×8); stops when CP isn't enough for a round
task.Arena.desc: Enters the Arena (激奏舞台) from the LIVE top page and plays multiplayer matches continuously: once matched with other players, a roulette picks the song, always on EXPERT. Matches don't need AP, so at least 1% GREATs are hit on purpose each round (more if Humanize is set higher). There is no song selection and "SKIP" is never tapped; there is no pause during play, so a failed sync can't be retried. The band, placement, rank point change and judgements of every round are recorded (data/arena.jsonl). LB is handled as in Repeat Play (set in the LB "Settings" on the Arena top page). If the song can't be recognized or the chart site has no chart for it, that round isn't played; it waits for the match to end and counts as a failure.
task.ArenaIdle.desc: Like AFK Farming, but in the Arena (see "Arena" for how rounds are played): when LB runs out, waits on the Arena top page until LB recovers to the per-round cost, then continues; with LB per round set to 0 it doesn't wait and plays nonstop. Scheduled Claim, Claim Dailies Each Day and refilling LB with items work as in AFK Farming. It never ends by itself, so put it last in the task list.
opt.ArenaBand.desc: Which band to pick on the Arena top page (switched with the ▶▶ next to the band logo)
opt.ArenaBand.current: Don't Switch (Keep the One Selected in Game)
opt.ArenaBand.rotate.desc: Starting with the currently selected band, switches to the next band after the set number of rounds, starting over after all five
opt.ArenaGamesPerBand.count: Rounds to play in a row with each band
opt.LbRefill: Refill LB with Items When Low
opt.LbRefill.desc: Before each round, if LB held is less than the per-round cost, goes through the LB "Settings" → "Recovery" and, only on the "Item" tab, uses Boost Drinks to top up just enough for this round (Small Boost Drinks first); never uses Stars or watches ads. Once the drinks run out or the set amount has been refilled, continues as before. Requires LB per round to be set to 1–5 or "Auto"
opt.LbRefillCount.count: Max LB to refill this run (0 = until the drinks run out)
opt.StudioClaim.desc: Claims Studio Practice once when AFK farming starts, then returns to the Home screen to claim again every set number of hours (between rounds or while waiting for LB, then comes back and continues AFK farming). Studio Practice accumulates for up to 12 hours; beyond that, efficiency drops to 30%
opt.DailyClaim.desc: Each day at the set time (the PC's local time), returns to the Home screen to claim Missions, Mission Pass, Limited-Time Missions, Beginner Missions, T.G.W CARD, the free gacha pull and the Gift Box (between rounds or while waiting for LB, then comes back and continues AFK farming); if not everything was claimed, tries again 10 minutes later. "Claim Dailies" in the task list only runs once before AFK farming; after crossing into a new day, this option takes care of it. The game's date changes at 3:00 every day; after AFK farming past 3:00, the new day's rewards are claimed at the set time
opt.LbCost.desc: Set in the LB "Settings" before the first round; if not enough is held, the game consumes all remaining LB
opt.ClearLbCost.desc: More LB gives more rewards per round; if not enough is held in the last round, the game consumes all remaining LB
opt.IdleLbCost.desc: More LB gives more rewards per round; if not enough is held in the last round, the game consumes all remaining LB. With 0 it doesn't wait for recovery: uses 1 per round while LB is held, then continues at 0 once it runs out, playing nonstop
opt.IdleLbCost.0: 0 (use LB if any; never wait, keep playing)
opt.LbCost.auto.desc: Each round picks the largest cost available for the LB held; if that's not enough, consumes all of it. "Consume All" is used when 10 or more LB are held, or when it saves 2 or more rounds, until today's uses run out (then not checked again that day)
opt.IdleLbCost.auto.desc: Each round picks the largest cost available for the LB held; if that's not enough, consumes all of it. "Consume All" is used when 10 or more LB are held, or when it saves 2 or more rounds, until today's uses run out (then not checked again that day). After running out, consumes again each time 1 LB recovers
opt.UseSkip.desc: In Free Live, first spends LB with "Skip" on the band confirmation screen (limited times per day; cost as set above), then plays once the skips run out. Doesn't skip when 0 LB is held
opt.ApMaxAttempts.count: Max plays of the same song (skipped if still not AP)
task.Daily.desc: Opens the selected pages in turn and taps "Claim All" only when it's lit; on the "Rewards Obtained" popup after claiming, only taps OK, and stops with an error instead of tapping any unrecognized confirmation dialog. Never does paid gacha pulls or spends Stars (only the daily free pull; in the Shop, only claims items priced "Free"), and never upgrades members. Launches the game first if it isn't running; ends on the Home screen. Daily missions are only complete after playing songs, so put it after the play tasks to claim everything together.
opt.DailyStudio.desc: Claims the rewards from member practice. Efficiency drops once practice time exceeds 12 hours, so claiming twice a day is worthwhile
opt.DailyStory.desc: Skips through unread Band Story, Another Story and Bond Story episodes one by one: certain episodes unlock songs, and finishing them also gives Stars and other rewards. Each episode downloads data the first time (Without Voice is chosen; about 30MB for Band Story), so it's slow when many are unread, and it's off by default. Locked ones (unlock conditions not met, Bond Rank too low) are not read
opt.DailyEvent.desc: During a limited-time event, skips through unread Event Story and Another Story episodes under "Event Story" on the event page one by one (finishing them gives rewards). Each Event Story episode only unlocks after the previous one is read; ones still locked are not read. Each episode downloads data the first time; off by default. Skipped when there is no limited-time event
opt.DailyMissions.desc: The Daily, Normal, Song Unlock and Home Unlock tabs of Missions
opt.DailyPass.desc: First claims the pts from Pass Missions (Daily, Normal), then claims the Mission Pass rewards. Free tier only; never purchases or taps the Premium tier
opt.DailyLimited.desc: Limited-Time Missions on the left of the Home screen during events; skipped when the entry isn't there
opt.DailyBeginner.desc: Beginner Missions on the left of the Home screen (tabbed by day); skipped when the entry isn't there
opt.DailyTgw.desc: Claims the daily points and daily reward on the T.G.W CARD page of the Shop, then claims items priced "Free" in the T.G.W CARD "Catalog Shop" (resets at 3:00 daily). Only taps "Free" ones, never items or packs that cost Stars; afterward checks that the Star count hasn't changed
opt.DailyRecruit.desc: When the gacha entry on the Home screen shows the "Free" badge, does the daily free pull (resets at 3:00 every day). Only taps the button labeled free / 1 pull; on the confirmation dialog, only taps OK when it says 0 Stars will be used, otherwise taps Cancel and stops with an error. Skips the pull animation with SKIP and then only taps the button back to the gacha top — never "Pull again", paid pulls or ads. The result is saved as a screenshot in data/recruit/ and shown in the MXU log; Stars are checked before and after. Only tested with the Simplified Chinese game language so far
opt.DailyGifts.desc: Claims the Gift Box last (mission rewards beyond the holding limit are sent here)
task.NotifyTest.desc: Sends a test message with the "Push Notifications" settings to check that they are right
